## Summary

One or two sentences on what this PR does and which task or sub-task it belongs to.

## Scope

- Branch: `taskN/main` or `taskN/N.M-slug` (or `chore/<slug>`, `docs/<slug>`)
- Base: the parent task branch `taskN/main` (or `main` for a task, chore, or docs branch)
- Files changed: list the key paths only

## Decisions

- Each decision made in this change, with its ID in `docs/decisions/` and its source (**[Spec]** or **[Decided]**)

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Criterion met, with the test or check that verifies it
- [ ] Criterion not yet met, with the reason

## Tests

- Commands run (`npm run check`, or `npm run typecheck` and `npm test`) and their results
- Edge cases covered, by name

## Docs updated

- Paths of the task or sub-task docs and decision records changed in this PR

## Review notes

- Anything the reviewer should look at closely, such as tradeoffs, open questions, or places where behavior was chosen over the spec

## Commit message

`taskN.M: <imperative summary>`
